_comment: EP-049 AC8 (SP-160) — the manuscript STORAGE FORMAT, as gestures → stored bytes. Run by BOTH platforms' tests: Apple's interop suite (real ManuscriptNSTextView, AppKit dispatch) and Linux's escape_smoke (real ManuscriptEditor). Offsets are UTF-16 units within one scene body. A change here is a change to the format: make it on Apple first.

cases.name: a typed backslash is itself escaped
AC4b: an insertion never lands between a backslash and its mark
backspace after a pair removes the whole pair
delete before a pair removes the whole pair
Return trims trailing spaces to one and stores a blank line
Return collapses a trailing typed backslash
Option/Alt-Return stores a hard line break: backslash + newline (T-0584, Q-E2-4 = (b))
Q3: backspace at a paragraph start joins with one space
Q3: the join reduces trailing spaces to one
Q3: a bare trailing backslash keeps its hard break
Q3: an empty paragraph below loses one newline
copy puts the writer's text on the clipboard
Scrivi's own copy pasted back is restored exactly (R2)
